Rework payment retry policy

Switched the payment retry policy from fixed backoff to exponential
backoff with jitter, after the incident review flagged synchronized
retries as a contributing cause of the outage.

Limit: payment provider sandbox throttles test traffic at 20 req/min
Ruled-out: circuit breaker only | doesn't address the thundering herd on recovery
Warn: do not lower the jitter window below 200ms, it was tuned against the provider's own rate limiter
Blast: module
Undo: costly
Certainty: firm
Verified: replayed the incident traffic trace against the new policy in staging
Unverified: behavior under provider-side partial outages
